entities.name: Raúl Quiroga
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Raúl Nicolás Quiroga is a retired volleyball player from Argentina who represented his native country in two Summer Olympics. After having finished in sixth place at the 1984 Summer Olympics in Los Angeles, he was a member of the men's national team that claimed the bronze medal four years later in Seoul.
